title: Establishment of Grievance Redressal Committee (GRC) and Ombudsman
description: Every AICTE-approved institution must establish a collegiate Student Grievance Redressal Committee (SGRC) headed by the Principal/Director with elected student representatives, and appoint an independent University Ombudsman. Failure to resolve grievances within 15 working days shall invite immediate AICTE bureau scrutiny.

title: Prohibition of Original Certificate Withholding & Mandatory Tuition Fee Refund
description: No institution shall withhold or retain original educational certificates, degrees, marksheets, transfer certificates (TC), or migration certificates under any pretext, including non-payment of disputed dues. In case of admission withdrawal prior to prescribed cut-off, full refund of tuition fee after deducting maximum processing fee of Rs. 1,000/- must be disbursed within 7 working days.

title: Strict Prohibition of Capitation Fee & Commercial Donations
description: Institutions are strictly prohibited from demanding, collecting, or accepting any capitation fee, development donation, building fund, or unauthorized levies directly or through third-party intermediaries. Violations constitute a cognizable offense under the Prohibition of Unfair Practices in Technical Educational Institutions Regulations.

title: Transparency in Fee Structure & Regulatory Fee Committee Compliance
description: Institutions must publish full breakups of tuition, examination, hostel, and laboratory fees on their official website before admissions commence. No fees higher than the ceiling approved by the State Fee Regulatory Committee shall be charged.

title: Zero Tolerance Against Ragging & Mandatory Anti-Ragging Cell
description: Technical institutions shall enforce zero tolerance towards ragging in campus, hostels, transport, or digital platforms pursuant to AICTE Regulations 2009. Mandatory registration of FIR within 24 hours of reported ragging is obligatory for institution heads.

title: Campus Safety Norms, CCTV Coverage, and Anonymous Complaint Drop-Boxes
description: Institutions must install functional CCTV systems covering common areas and hostel gates, maintain anonymous complaint drop-boxes cleared weekly by the SGRC, and provide round-the-clock emergency helpline contact details.

title: Faculty Cadre Ratio and Mandatory 7th CPC Salary Disbursement
description: Institutions must maintain the statutory faculty-to-student cadre ratio of 1:15 (or 1:20 in non-engineering technical programs) with Cadre Proportion of 1 Professor : 2 Associate Professors : 6 Assistant Professors. Salaries must be disbursed through bank transfer adhering to 7th Central Pay Commission scales.

title: Mandatory Infrastructure Norms, Computing Facilities, and Laboratory Standards
description: Institutions must possess clear unencumbered land, barrier-free access for Divyangjan, licensed engineering software, high-speed broadband, and fully equipped laboratories matching AICTE model curriculum requirements.

title: Inter-Bureau Synchronization & Multi-Agency Regulatory Inquiry
description: Where an institution faces concurrent inquiries across PGRC, Regulation Bureau, or Regional Offices, a harmonized Joint Inquiry protocol must be initiated under AICTE Samanvay. No conflicting unilateral directives shall be issued without inter-bureau clearance.

title: Regulatory Penalties: Intake Reduction, Approval Suspension, and Zero Admission
description: For substantiated non-compliance with AICTE regulations or failure to implement SGRC orders, the Council may impose penalties including: (a) 50% reduction in approved intake, (b) suspension of approval for 1 academic year, (c) placement in 'No Admission' status, or (d) forfeiture of performance guarantee.

title: Disgorgement of Unlawful Collections & Blacklisting of Defaulter Societies
description: The Council may order the disgorgement and direct refund of any unlawfully collected funds or capitation levies with 12% annual interest. Chronic institutional defaulters and governing trust members may be recommended for national blacklisting.
